content:
I've been on the hunt for ultra-thin accessories that complement my everyday carry, and I really appreciate how tech companies and brands make their products so slim. I typically avoid anything too bulky or lacking in thoughtful design. As a result, I've tried countless accessories, ranging from power banks, stands, and magnetic cables, to many other types of products. In this article, I want to share a few accessories I absolutely love, which are not only ultra-thin and portable but also highly versatile.

Be sure to check out my hands-on video, where I demonstrate all the mentioned devices as well as others. The video features 11 noteworthy compact and slim accessories!

This is a product I've recently added to my everyday carry, and the user experience has been excellent. The Snap Grip Stand is made by the same team that created the original Popsocket. It's truly astonishing that they managed to make such a slim product. Its thickness is essentially comparable to the camera plateau on the iPhone. Its main features include:

  • Features a Popsocket-like ring for single or two-finger grip
  • Equipped with a separate adjustable metal stand that rotates 350 degrees
  • Supports both portrait and landscape viewing
  • Features dual-sided magnets, meaning you can attach more MagSafe accessories on top of the stand itself

Even to this day, I still can't figure out how they managed to pack so many features into such a thin and lightweight stand, but it has become a permanent stable fixture on my iPhone. It's so thin that you can wirelessly charge your phone even with the accessory attached! Another great feature is that because it's so thin, it actually eliminates phone wobble when placed on a table!

The Snap Grip Stand is currently available on its official website for $39.99, available in four colors: black, green, light purple, and silver. The manufacturer also sells the ring component separately for $29.99, offered in 18 colors—far too many to list individually. For any iPhone user, this is a product that's incredibly easy to recommend.

This one has always been a top favorite of mine. On the surface, it's just another 3-in-1 charger for your Apple devices, but its build quality, versatile design, and value for money are what truly set it apart. These include:

  • MagSafe-compatible Qi2.2 25W charger
  • 5W Apple Watch charger
  • 5W AirPods charger
  • Foldable CNC aluminum alloy design

This device is extremely compact, slim, and lightweight. The Kuxiu X40 Turbo can fold down to charge just the iPhone, unfold into a 3-in-1 charging stand, and can also be used fully flat. Its thinnest point is only 18mm, and when folded, it fits in the palm of your hand. The best part is that it comes with the 45W power adapter needed to support 25W fast charging, and even includes a hard-shell carrying case that can hold all the accessories. It's a seriously underrated device.

The Kuxiu X40 Turbo is available on the Kuxiu official website for $78, available in five styles: gray, black, wood grain, orange, and cherry. It's the first charger that perfectly matched the Cosmic Orange iPhone right out of the gate! At $78, you get the charger, a braided cable, a 45W power adapter, and a carrying case.

Up next is a product that's even more impressive. I absolutely love ultra-compact and slim MagSafe power banks. Large MagSafe batteries certainly have their uses at times, but if I need to charge while using my phone, I'd rather pick a smaller-capacity battery that adds extra juice to my phone without turning it into a two-pound brick in my hand. Right now, the thinnest and lightest MagSafe power bank is the SolidSafe Air. Specifications include:

  • 5,000mAh battery capacity
  • 6.8mm ultra-thin body
  • Supports up to 15W Qi2 wireless charging
  • USB-C output up to 20W
  • Can charge two devices simultaneously

I own three of these batteries, and no matter where I go, I always bring one along. My iPhone 17 Pro can no longer last through a full day of use, so carrying this power bank daily is essential for me. They are lightweight, look and feel premium, and come in several great color options.

The SolidSafe Air 5K is available on the BMX website for $59, available in three colors: black, silver, and gold. You can also opt for the two-pack or three-pack to save a bit. For the next generation, my only hope is that they replace the LED indicator with a small display, provided the thickness doesn't increase!

This product is interesting for iPhone photography enthusiasts, or anyone who wants to shoot in well-lit conditions without carrying bulky equipment. The SnapPocket is a small, lightweight light ring that magnetically attaches to the back of your phone. It also flips over, so you get excellent lighting when using the front camera as well. Features include:

  • Built-in 8 LED lights
  • Maximum brightness of 90 lumens
  • Four adjustable brightness levels
  • Flippable and MagSafe-compatible design
  • Built-in battery with USB-C charging

Judging from the specs, the SnapPocket is twice as bright as the iPhone's built-in flash and provides a more consistent light source, making it especially suitable for video recording. Like all other accessories, the focus is on portability and compactness. It can fit into any pocket or bag, and since it's MagSafe-compatible, it can even stay attached to the phone at all times.

The ShiftCam SnapPocket Light is available on Amazon for $33 (using the promo code on the product page). It's available in black, blue, and gray. For those looking to enhance their iPhone photography without spending too much or adding complicated gear, this is the perfect gift.

I've mentioned this product before, but I use it so frequently that I wanted to bring it up again. Everyone knows SSD prices are getting higher and higher, but currently buying an external SSD is still far more cost-effective than purchasing more built-in storage for your iPhone. Therefore, whenever I want to shoot ProRes video, I always use the Lexar ES5 SSD. It magnetically attaches to the phone and features a built-in USB-C cable, allowing me to save directly to the SSD without taking up the iPhone's storage. Specifications include:

  • Read/write speeds up to 2,000MB/s
  • Supports USB 3.2 Gen 2×2 connectivity
  • Supports direct ProRes recording up to 4K/120 fps
  • IP65 protection rating with 3-meter drop resistance
  • Capacity up to 4TB

The design is another reason it appeals to me and why I use it more often than other SSDs. It's small and lightweight, with slightly rounded corners, making it more ergonomic when holding the phone.

The Lexar ES5 is available on Amazon, with the 1TB version starting at $199. Although the price is higher than it was a few months ago, it's still much cheaper than buying an iPhone with 1TB of built-in storage.

Summary

As mentioned above, be sure to check out my video, in which I'll be demonstrating 11 compact and slim products that I think readers will love. These five are just my absolute favorites among them. What I value most is minimizing the burden as much as possible, and these accessories fit the bill perfectly. From the ultra-thin and practical Snap Grip Stand to the extremely useful Lexar SSD, each one serves a practical purpose without requiring me to carry large, heavy accessories.

What do you think of these products? Have you tried any of them before? What are your favorite accessories in this category? Let's discuss in the comments below.
